title: ezdxf SAB authoring, LibreDWG AcDs reproducer, and schema-index safety crosswalk
mode: Primary-source research and implementation-readiness update; research-only
scope: Reconcile ezdxf 1.4.5 current ACIS API with its explicitly old FAQ.
Refresh the reproducibility and evidence boundary of LibreDWG issue #1411.
Crosswalk a reported AcDs schema-property-type index risk to the local DataStorage parser and propose one focused fast negative test.
Preserve scratch-only fixture policy, composed external gates, and non-promoting deferred statuses.

sources.revision: Current stable documentation identifies itself as ezdxf 1.4.5; reviewed 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: The ACIS API documents body_from_mesh, export_dxf, export_sat, and export_sab; SAT v700 for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB v21800 for R2013/R2018. Its support is limited to known structures and mesh-derived flat polyhedra; unsupported nodes may become NONE_ENTITY and arbitrary ACIS load/re-export is unsupported. The FAQ says SAT-only/no creation but labels itself the old FAQ through late 2023.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Optional pinned scratch producer for exact mesh-derived DXF profiles; not a general ACIS kernel, arbitrary carrier round-trip, DWG AcDs producer, or semantic oracle for its own generated output.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-02; reported executable built from 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764 on Linux x86-64.
sources.observed: The issue contains a source-from-scratch AC1032 DXF REGION recipe using ezdxf body_from_mesh/export_dxf and reports 5,489 SAB bytes before a DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF path drops ACDSDATA/SAB. A separate AutoCAD R2018 drawing with 88 REGION entities is confidential and unavailable.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Issue-reported repro and historical LibreDWG result, not an independently reproduced current-master result; reported payload length is not a golden hash or semantic oracle.

sources.observed: NEWS says AcDsPrototype_1b is not fully decoded and modern SAB extraction used brute-force search. Current acds.spec defines a schema property-type size table indexed by a parsed type value.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source-level peer architecture and limitation context only; no immutable build or runtime qualification.

sources.observed: Reports an out-of-bounds read involving an unchecked AcDs schema property-type index in LibreDWG through 0.14.8612 and links the LibreDWG decoder source.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Third-party security lead only; not a confirmed libdxfrw defect, not a normative format source, and not proof of current mutable-master or later-artifact behavior.

localEvidence: src/drw_datastorage.cpp validates a parsed schema property type against SCHEMA_PROPERTY_TYPE_COUNT before indexing the local type-size table.
tests/graph_preservation_tests.cpp builds generated DataStorage schema controls with ordinary property types including 10 and 15.
A source search during this review found no generated type-16 or larger invalid-type assertion in the current DataStorage regression code.
ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains the authority for DWG field layout and legal values.

assessment.planImpact: Corrects the ezdxf FAQ/API freshness assessment, adds a scratch-only AC1032 SAB carrier recipe to the existing composed gate, and recommends focused invalid schema-type vectors under the existing DataStorage fast-test owner. All external semantic qualification remains separate and non-promoting.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local parser/test/plan crosswalk
